python_mqtt_init.message0: initialize MQTT client %1 client ID %2 protocol %3 transport %4
python_mqtt_init.tooltip: Create a Paho MQTT 2.x client with Callback API VERSION2. Client IDs should be unique on the broker.

python_mqtt_set_tls.message0: MQTT %1 enable TLS CA file %2 client certificate %3 private key %4
python_mqtt_set_tls.tooltip: Enable verified TLS before connecting. Leave CA empty to use the system trust store; client certificate and key are optional.

python_mqtt_set_will.message0: MQTT %1 set will topic %2 payload %3 QoS %4 retain %5
python_mqtt_set_will.tooltip: Set the last-will message before connecting.

python_mqtt_set_websocket_options.tooltip: Set the broker WebSocket path before connecting; use with a WebSocket client transport.

python_mqtt_set_reconnect_delay.message0: MQTT %1 set reconnect delay minimum %2 maximum %3 seconds
python_mqtt_set_reconnect_delay.tooltip: Configure exponential automatic-reconnect delays used by the background and forever network loops. Manual single-step loop calls do not reconnect automatically.

python_mqtt_connect.message0: MQTT %1 connect host %2 port %3 keepalive %4 seconds
python_mqtt_connect.tooltip: Start an MQTT connection. The broker CONNACK result is delivered only after a network loop runs.

python_mqtt_on_connect.message0: when MQTT %1 connection result set success %2 reason %3 session present %4 do %5 %6
python_mqtt_on_connect.tooltip: Handle Paho Callback API VERSION2 connection results. Subscribe here so subscriptions are restored after reconnecting.

python_mqtt_on_message.message0: when MQTT %1 receives message set topic %2 payload bytes %3 QoS %4 retained %5 do %6 %7
python_mqtt_on_message.tooltip: Handle an incoming message. Payload is bytes; decode it explicitly when text is required.

python_mqtt_on_disconnect.message0: when MQTT %1 disconnects set reason %2 server MQTT DISCONNECT packet received %3 do %4 %5
python_mqtt_on_disconnect.tooltip: Handle a Paho Callback API VERSION2 disconnect event and its reason code.

python_mqtt_publish.message0: MQTT %1 publish topic %2 payload %3 QoS %4 retain %5
python_mqtt_publish.tooltip: Queue a message for publishing. Use the wait-for-publish block before a prompt exit when delivery must complete.

python_mqtt_publish_wait.message0: MQTT %1 publish topic %2 payload %3 QoS %4 retain %5 and wait %6 seconds
python_mqtt_publish_wait.tooltip: Wait for publication to complete. If the timeout expires while the message is still unpublished, raise TimeoutError. Do not use this inside a network callback.

python_mqtt_subscribe.tooltip: Subscribe to a topic filter. Place this inside the connection callback to restore it after reconnecting.

python_mqtt_decode_payload.message0: decode MQTT payload %1 as %2 on error %3
python_mqtt_decode_payload.tooltip: Decode MQTT payload bytes into text with an explicit encoding and error policy.

python_mqtt_is_connected.tooltip: Return whether the Paho client currently considers itself connected.

python_mqtt_loop_start.tooltip: Start Paho's background network thread. Do not mix this with loop forever or manual loop calls.

python_mqtt_loop_stop.tooltip: Stop Paho's background network thread; this does not by itself guarantee pending publications were sent.

python_mqtt_loop_once.message0: MQTT %1 process network once timeout %2 seconds
python_mqtt_loop_once.tooltip: Process network traffic once. Call regularly and keep timeout below keepalive; do not mix network-loop modes.

python_mqtt_loop.tooltip: Run Paho's blocking network loop forever. Following statements normally run only after disconnection or an error.

python_mqtt_disconnect.tooltip: Request a clean MQTT disconnection. Stop a background loop after disconnecting.
